fact: A benchmark dataset of crowd-sourced Mozambican Portuguese SMS messages for detecting mobile money smishing, MOZ-Smishing, was released under an open licence on Hugging Face, by authors including Universidade Lúrio staff.
title: MOZ-Smishing: A Benchmark Dataset for Detecting Mobile Money Frauds
publisher: Association for Computational Linguistics (Sixth Workshop on African Natural Language Processing, AfricaNLP 2025)
